verdict.rationale: Extend is an AI document-processing platform. It produces AI-generated structured outputs from user documents, with per-field confidence scores and citations that support routing low-confidence values to human review. The pricing page also lists a "Composer & Review Agent" and Studio-based optimization, which hint at in-product AI suggestions, but none of these is described as delivering insights or recommendations about the user's data. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or analysis of the user's data, a description of what Composer or the Review Agent actually suggests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
